The crushing core is held to the shaft by hasty bands and crude pins. It groans with loose play when swung, though the terrifying gravity of its impact remains undiminished.
Fitted with precision collars that channel kinetic force through the breeze rod, delivering thunderous, earth-shaking smashes from above.
